headline: Caltech and the American Institute of Mathematics are building an AI platform designed with mathematicians.
score_reason: Official university announcement of a new research tool for a field that is debating AI; no results yet.
importance_line: It gives mathematicians a shared AI tool they help design, but the platform is not yet built or tested, and the team says a major redesign depends on funding it has not yet secured.
summary: Caltech says it is building, with the American Institute of Mathematics, an AI software platform designed with mathematicians to organise their work and suggest conjectures and proof strategies. A preliminary version is due within a few months for teams of mathematicians to test, and the team plans a major redesign after about a year of user feedback.
notes: Full text read. Named people with position: Sergei Gukov (executive director of the American Institute of Mathematics), Pietro Perona (director of Caltech's Information Science and Technology initiative) and Yisong Yue (Caltech professor of computing and mathematical sciences). Not named in the summary.
